messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from today's tri-mode sync. Need a compact telemetry contract for HOSTED/DEDICATED/PRIVATE handoffs that avoids metric-cardinality explosions. Proposed minimal tags: hosting_mode, route_path, variant_bucket, routing_version, fallback_reason. Thoughts?

liam: +1. Keep values finite. Suggest enums: hosting_mode=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PRIVATE; route_path=PREFERRED|FALLBACK|DEGRADED; variant_bucket=perf|balanced|accurate|other; fallback_reason=none|capacity|compat|auth|quota; routing_version short token (v1,v2).

zoe (sec): Security note: never emit raw tenant IDs in hosted metrics. Private deployments may put tenant context into their own audit sinks only. Any trace sampling that captures request payloads must be explicit opt-in per customer.

sam: Implementation: propagate via lightweight headers at first runtime hop so adapters can annotate/override. Draft headers: `X-RW-Hosting-Mode`, `X-RW-Route-Path`, `X-RW-Variant-Bucket`, `X-RW-Routing-Version`, `X-RW-Fallback-Reason`, `X-RW-Telemetry-Sample`. Traces (sampled) may include full model name only when allowed.

tanya: Runtime should keep a small mapping table model_name -> variant_bucket. New/unmapped models map to "other" and emit an ops alert. Precedence for multi-hop: hosting_mode = first non-UNKNOWN; route_path = most_degraded seen (if any stage used FALLBACK mark FALLBACK).

liam: Exporter must canonicalize unexpected tag values to "other" and log an alert to avoid typos or new names causing cardinality spikes. Dashboards must migrate to the normalized tag set.

ops-bot: Reminder: runtime deploy window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tag @sam if you want it. :calendar:

maya: OK action items: maya update RFC with enums + header examples; sam PR for header emit + mapping API; liam exporter normalization; zoe telemetry policy text. I'll post RFC patch by EOD.
